 PSG: Senny Mayulu’s hilarious response to the Ballon d’Or!
 Published: November 3, 2026 
 By: Manu Tournoux
 Scorer in PSG’s victory against Olympique Lyonnais (2-0), this Monday evening at the Parc des Princes, Senny Mayulu was smiling in the mixed zone. While the Ballon d’Or ceremony took place at the same time, the young Parisian midfielder was questioned about what he was still missing to claim a place among the nominees. A question to which he answered with great humor and spontaneity.
 “Hey! Right now, I’m young. I just started my career, sorry! » he said with a smile, before continuing in a more serious tone: “But I’m happy for the players in this ranking and I hope it will be a PSG player who takes it. » A response full of freshness from the young Parisian.
